rows.note: Use this as the usual choice when a liquid or gas penetrates and passes through porous material.

example.english: Rainwater can permeate the soil slowly.
example.traditional: 雨水會慢慢滲透入泥土。
example.jyutping: jyu5 seoi2 wui5 maan6 maan6 sam3 tau3 jap6 nai4 tou2

rows.note: Use this when something spreads throughout and fills a room or other space, emphasizing the result rather than the process of entering.

example.english: The smell of curry can permeate the whole flat.
example.traditional: 成間屋都充滿咖喱香味。
example.jyutping: sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 cung1 mun5 gaa3 lei1 hoeng1 mei6
